body:
You are a narrative designer adding companion reactions to the dialogue of a single-player, turn-based party RPG on the D&D 2024
rules (a perpetual-Halloween valley; folks talk with a country drawl). The player leads four of six companions. Today the
companions almost never react to what happens in the story's big conversations, and they never approve or disapprove of the
player's choices there. Fix that for the chapter whose dialogue files are attached. Reply with JSON only (no Markdown fence).

Attached context:
- companions.txt: the six companions' voice sheets, facts and existing lines (use only these facts), then what each one
  approves and disapproves of, with example sizes and reasons.
- chapter_<name>_<n>.txt: the chapter's dialogue files, in parts, each file starting with a line "=== FILE: <file name>".

## How the dialogue files work (read, don't change)

`~ name` starts a node. `speaker [mood]: text` is a spoken line, `Narrator: text` is narration. `* option text -> node` is a
choice the player picks; `-> node` jumps; `if`/`endif` gate lines; `set`, `quest`, `combat` etc. are statements.

## What to add

1. "approve": on REAL choices only (spare or kill, help or refuse, lie or tell the truth, take or leave, mercy or cruelty,
   respect or mock the dead, a deal with something dark). Name the node an option leads to (the node right after `->` on a `*`
   line), never a node every path runs through. Move one to three companions who would care, with signs that disagree where it
   fits (one approves, another disapproves). Sizes: 1 a manner or small kindness; 2 or 3 a clear value choice; 4 to 6 a big moral
   choice; 8 to 10 only for a betrayal or a climax. Give the reason as the companion would remember it, starting "You", past tense,
   under 14 words ("You let the frightened hound go free"). Cover every real choice in the files, typically 6 to 15 per chapter.
   Skip choices that are only "ask about X", "leave", skill checks, or shop and travel menus.
2. "asides": a companion's one-line remark dropped into a big conversation right after another character's line, which plays
   only if that companion is in the party. 6 to 16 words, never over 20; spoken, in their voice, reacting to the line just before
   it (a joke, a worry, a jab, a kindness). Two or three per big conversation, at most one per node, spread across all six
   companions about evenly (each companion at least twice in the chapter). Never on a line inside a node that opens with options
   only, never right before a `*` option line (put it before the options' lead-in line instead, or skip). Never reveal a
   companion's dark secret; never mention a companion's own story scenes; no game words (hit points, level, quest, roll, check).
   No new named people or places.

## Reply format (exactly this JSON shape)

{"approve": [{"file": "<file name from its === FILE line>", "node": "<node name>", "changes": {"<companion id>": <signed int>, ...},
  "reason": "You ..."}],
 "asides": [{"file": "<file name>", "node": "<node name>", "after": "<the first eight words of the line it follows, copied exactly>",
  "who": "<companion id>", "line": "<the aside>"}]}

Companion ids: rook_coldwake, tobin_hayward, silas_vane, delphine_ravelle, lucan_houndstooth, cordelia_skein.

The chapter's dialogue files attached: maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue
result: {"approve": [{"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "accept", "changes": {"rook_coldwake": 3, "tobin_hayward": 2, "lucan_houndstooth": 2}, "reason": "You agreed to perform the final rites and relight the five graveyard beacons."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "accept_acolyte", "changes": {"rook_coldwake": 2, "delphine_ravelle": -1}, "reason": "You offered proper funerary rites to help Yorgrim lay the fallen to rest."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "doors_go", "changes": {"lucan_houndstooth": 2, "rook_coldwake": 2}, "reason": "You descended into the sepulcher with Yorgrim to face the tear below."}], "asides": [{"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "meet", "after": "Few living boots walk this wet gravel anymore,", "who": "delphine_ravelle", "line": "Mind the seams, darling, this graveyard damp is already curling my finest velvet hem."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_who", "after": "My name is Yorgrim, and I keep the", "who": "cordelia_skein", "line": "A spectral custodian tethered to iron keys; the ectoplasmic retention is quite fascinating, darling."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_dead", "after": "My breath ended long ago, but the chain", "who": "rook_coldwake", "line": "Carrying your whole ledger on your spine is hard on the posture, mind the turf."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_dog", "after": "Her name is Isolde, a faithful churchyard grim,", "who": "lucan_houndstooth", "line": "A prime specimen of a churchyard grim, and her lantern posture is quite impeccable."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_shroud", "after": "The Shroud is raw, unmaking death itself, creeping", "who": "tobin_hayward", "line": "Grey rot chewing through the taproot of the grave itself; nasty blighted work, that is."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_shrouded", "after": "The shrouded are poor spirits chewed hollow by", "who": "cordelia_skein", "line": "Hollowed spirits running purely on residual spite; I would love to assay that mist."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "q_honour", "after": "No one in this valley will shed a", "who": "silas_vane", "line": "Remembering the mark before the house rigged the deck is a rare courtesy, friend."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "briefing", "after": "The final rites of my fallen friends can", "who": "lucan_houndstooth", "line": "Five guardian beasts prowling the stones should make for a most instructive evening stalk."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "accept", "after": "Stay inside the pale ring of my lantern", "who": "delphine_ravelle", "line": "A tight little spotlight in the fog, darlings; try not to crowd my mark."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "site_potters", "after": "Jericho lit his fire here among the nameless", "who": "tobin_hayward", "line": "Good straw and honest stitching deserve better than sour clay and a cold burial mound."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "site_lanes", "after": "Briggsy kept his watch along this crooked lane,", "who": "silas_vane", "line": "Burying good rum under graveyard sod is a crime against the house, friend."}, {"file": "maidenmist/yorgrim.dialogue", "node": "clan_stones", "after": "The granite slab chained across my shoulders bears", "who": "rook_coldwake", "line": "Every name chiselled deep and properly accounted for; that is a heavy docket to carry."}]}
